goal: Propagate the persisted SYSTEM/LIGHT/DARK ThemePreference from the retained production graph into the shared Material3 root so both platforms and all screens re-render immediately, while SYSTEM continues to react to OS appearance and previews remain deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: Production AppTheme resolves SYSTEM from isSystemInDarkTheme and forces LIGHT or DARK overrides without mutating the stored preference.
The retained ProductSettings theme StateFlow reaches Android and iOS RootApp; a Settings update immediately re-renders all screens and survives restart through existing persistence.
Android and iOS system-bar/status appearance callbacks receive the resolved dark value, including after preference or system appearance changes.

Tests prove the SYSTEM/LIGHT/DARK truth table and production propagation; existing deterministic light/dark Settings and Today previews remain golden-ready with semantic Material color roles. Specialist does not run Gradle.
